verdict.rationale: Solid documents predictable fine-grained reactivity: only code that depends on a piece of state reruns, dependencies are tracked automatically, and components run once so rendering follows directly from how state is used. A long-term user also reports that immediate reactivity keeps state changes intuitive and easy to debug. However, nothing in the pack states that Solid uses explicit one-way data flow rather than two-way bindings. A hands-on critique calls the dev tools alpha/unusable, and another user finds the reactive system non-intuitive, both of which weaken the 'trace state changes' part of the story. Missing for 10: first-party evidence of explicit unidirectional data flow and no implicit two-way binding, and mature tooling for tracing state changes.
